Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

1.	The proposed four residential townhouse and nine unit apartment development by reason of its' size, scale and positioning would unduly overshadow the habitable spaces of the adjacent properties in Vineyard Road and Charleston Close and would also result in a loss of privacy and open outlook, which is considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.

2.	The proposed four residential townhouse and nine unit apartment development by reason of its' design, location and appearance would not complement the style or building materials of the surrounding building environment and would be a visually incongruous feature.  Furthermore, it does not meet the requirements of the 'Secured by Design' guidelines and is considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.

3.	The proposed development would exceed the maximum density level identified in the UDP and would represent an over-development of the site to the detriment of the surrounding area.  It is therefore considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.2 (Residential Density) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003

4.	The proposed nine-unit apartment development would not be provided with any private or communal amenity space, to the detriment of the amenity of the occupiers of the units and would therefore be contrary with policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
